Hi Ryan,

Your blend of operating and investing experience—spanning CFO roles at fast‑growth AI tech firms, a public‑company CFO stint at Atlas, and recent leadership at Kaseya—positions you uniquely for IFS’s current momentum in Industrial AI. Rapid growth and fresh leadership often cause intercompany reconciliation sprawl, slowing finance efficiency. Our platform lets operations teams automate those manual, reconciliation‑heavy tasks, freeing your finance organization to focus on strategic growth. Would you be open to a brief call to explore how we can support IFS’s scaling journey?

Best,
Zamp
